'''Barriss's kiosk'''<ref name="Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> was a personal cubicle of the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. It was located in the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. The cubicle was located twenty meters from the triage area.<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />

At some point after her arrival at the RMSU-7<ref name="Battle Surgeons" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Barriss Offee attempted the [[Floating Meditation]], sat down on the floor of her cubicle and assumed the meditative position called the [[Repose]]. Her legs were crossed and knotted, the ankles were over the thighs, her back was straight, and the hands rested palms-up on the knees. She breathed slowly, drawing the air in through the right nostril and expelling it through the left. As she failed to float, Barriss remembered the lesson [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] taught her back on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and, after clearing her mind, floated upward from the floor.<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />
